notes.title: New Update: Tower Defense Mode is Here!
notes.content:
I’am excited to introduce the latest update to our game: Tower Defense Mode! Get ready to defend your base against relentless waves of enemies in this brand-new gameplay experience.

In this update, your base becomes the ultimate hub for strategy and survival. Upgrade your towers, fortify your defenses, and take on increasingly challenging waves of foes. The stronger your defenses, the further you’ll go!

And this is just the beginning—future updates will bring even more upgrades for your base, offering countless ways to enhance your towers, unlock powerful abilities, and refine your defenses.

It’s time to step into the fight and prove your skills. Are you ready to build, defend, and conquer?

Download the update now and experience the thrill of Tower Defense Mode!
